entry.title: Snowball to Snowstorm
entry.summary:
A recently shared research paper introduces a protocol designed to facilitate soft-agreement within the Bitcoin mempool before block discovery. This approach aims to accelerate block propagation throughout the network, thereby improving the efficiency of machine utilization during transaction processing and block creation.
The protocol leverages elements from several existing consensus mechanisms, synthesizing them into a system reminiscent of the Snowball protocol. However, instead of focusing on individual transactions, this protocol operates over groups of transactions, allowing for batch agreement among network participants. By adopting this collective decision-making process in the mempool stage, the protocol enhances coordination and reduces redundancies in transaction selection, leading to more streamlined block formation and dissemination.
Further details and technical specifications can be found in the original paper: [https://beige-worrying-unicorn-969.mypinata.cloud/ipfs/bafybeigsbdid4znwtmoqh55yid2etxkujci33dzqt3ia6bt5vwsnllfqym](https://beige-worrying-unicorn-969.mypinata.cloud/ipfs/bafybeigsbdid4znwtmoqh55yid2etxkujci33dzqt3ia6bt5vwsnllfqym).
